name: Harshdeep Hortico Ltd
tagline: Rs ~130 Cr BSE-SME micro-cap in premium pots, planters and garden decor with ~25% ROE, near-zero debt and 25-30% revenue growth into new verticals - genuinely fast-growing, but cash flow is currently locked in working capital
business_overview: Harshdeep Hortico (BSE-SME listed Feb 2024) manufactures and markets premium pots and planters, decorative planters, garden accessories, shade nets and outdoor furniture, plus newer verticals 'Agri Shield' and 'Muebles' (furniture). It sells to nurseries, garden centres, landscapers, architects and institutional buyers - airports, hotels, builders and infrastructure projects - where execution and reliability matter more than price.
fundamentals_table: FY latest ~Rs 69 Cr revenue, ~Rs 13 Cr PAT; H1 FY26 revenue +31% YoY to ~Rs 33 Cr, PAT +35% to ~Rs 5.7 Cr
First dividend declared while still in expansion; promoter family retains a large stake
fundamentals_narrative: For a micro-cap the return profile is strong - ~25% ROE, ~24% ROIC, near-zero debt - and growth is real and broad-based (H1 FY26 revenue +31%, PAT +35%), driven by new categories (outdoor furniture, shade nets), exports and distribution expansion. The clear weakness, flagged by forum members, is cash conversion: free cash flow is currently negative because inventory and working capital are absorbing cash during the scale-up, and operating-level cash flows look slim. The claimed moat is not a single dominant one but a combination - 500+ designs and 2,200+ SKUs on a mould library built over years, a nationwide dealer/nursery/landscaper network, and institutional relationships that take time to earn.
